title: Hari ke-1: Pulau ini punya nama

scenes.narration: Kemarin, pulau ini gelap total. Malam ini… ada tiga lampu.
scenes.visual: Night sea, slow push-in on a lighthouse on a rocky point of the island. Three small lamps on the island blink on one by one, each landing on the spoken count. Title card at the top: 'Hari ke-1: Pulau ini punya nama'.

scenes.narration: Tiga orang follow. Tiga orang datang ke pulau. Aru tidak sendirian lagi.
scenes.visual: Morning at Aru's camp. Campfire, palm, tent. Three new residents walk in from the edges; Aru waves and greets them. Top text 'PENDUDUK: 1 → 4' ticks up with each arrival.

scenes.narration: Setiap warga baru, namanya diukir di sini. Selamanya.
scenes.visual: Aru walks to the Batu Nama, a tall standing stone. A panel slides open and three name plates carve themselves in with chisel sparks. Glow on 'Selamanya'.

scenes.narration: Lalu semua komentar kalian masuk ke undian. Diacak… diacak… dan terpilih!
scenes.visual: Phone-style UI of the 'Undian' tab: comment cards pasted in, the 'UNDI' button pressed, a slot-machine shuffle of comment cards that slows and stops on the winner.

scenes.narration: Komentar dari SUPREME: namanya ganti, Pulau Netizen.
scenes.visual: Winner card zooms up: 'SUPREME®' and 'namanya ganti pulau netizen'. Confetti bursts.

scenes.narration: Mulai hari ini, namanya Pulau Netizen. Karena memang kalian yang mengatur.
scenes.visual: UI panel 'Kelola → Pulau': old name erased, 'Pulau Netizen' typed, 'Terbitkan' pressed. Cut to the island where the HUD title flips from 'Pulau Tanpa Nama' to 'Pulau Netizen'; Aru cheers.

scenes.narration: Dan untuk emoji moai-nya, kami taruh patung di samping Batu Nama.
scenes.visual: A big stone statue head drops from above beside the Batu Nama with a dust puff; Aru jumps back, then grins. The statue blinks once.

scenes.narration: Tapi Aru masih belum cerita, bagaimana dia sampai ke sini…
scenes.visual: Dusk. The camera slides along the shore to a broken boat. Slow zoom to a rope tied in a perfectly neat knot, a magnifier ring highlights it. Mystery mood.

scenes.narration: Pulau ini bisa kamu kunjungi. Buka link-nya, masukkan username TikTok-mu, dan cari namamu di Batu Nama. Komentar: besok kita bangun apa?
scenes.visual: A phone in hand opens the game; a resident walks around the island on the screen. Big text 'bit.ly/pulau-ara' and 'link juga di bio' above, then the question 'Besok kita bangun apa?'.
